question:
Create a new KiCad project named b10 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Build a passive RAM-tester adapter with a DIP-20 tester plug, a 28-pin SOJ socket for x4 DRAM, a 28-pin SOJ socket for x1 DRAM, and separate odd/even ZIP rows for 1M x1 and 41256 devices. DIP/SOJ numbering is counter-clockwise. Define Pn as tester-plug pin n, with P20 = GND. The following lists specify the required custom socket interface; '-' means unused and each list is in ascending socket pin order.
SOJ x4 pins 1-28: P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, -, -, -, P6, P7, P8, P9, P10, -, -, P11, P12, P13, P14, P15, -, -, -, P16, P17, P18, P19, P20.
SOJ x1 pins 1-28: P1, P2, P3, P9, -, -, -, -, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9, -, -, P12, P13, P14, P15, P16, -, -, -, P17, -, P18, P19, P20.
1M x1 odd row: P17, P19, P1, P3, -, P5, P7, P9, P13, P15; even row: P18, P20, P2, P9, -, P6, P8, P12, P14, P16. 41256 odd row: P17, P19, P1, P3, P5, P7, P13, P15; even row: P18, P20, P2, P4, P6, P8, P14, P16. Use 2.54 mm ZIP rows and no active parts.
Local dependencies: This project doesn't require custom libraries; use standard KiCad libraries.
answer:
Created the [b10 KiCad project](./b10.kicad_pro) and its [schematic](./b10.kicad_sch).

The passive adapter includes the DIP-20 plug, both SOJ socket interfaces, and separate 2.54 mm ZIP rows, wired to the requested mapping. All sockets share the tester nets; **test one device at a time**.

ERC reports **0 errors and 7 symbol-library mismatch warnings**. The SOJ socket footprints remain unassigned pending selection of the actual sockets; verify the assumed DIP plug and ZIP-row footprints against the hardware.
